purpose: Stable immutable environment rows, secret masking and import lifecycle isolation

diagnostics.title: Array index used as a key
diagnostics.message: Your users can see & submit the wrong data when this list reorders or filters, so use a stable id like `key={item.id}`, not the array index "index".
diagnostics.help: Use a stable id from the item, like `key={item.id}` or `key={item.slug}`. Index keys break when the list reorders or filters.

diagnostics.title: Icon-only Button without accessible name
diagnostics.message: This icon-only Button has no accessible name, so screen readers announce an unnamed button. Add aria-label or an sr-only text child (e.g. Delete).
diagnostics.help: Give every icon-sized Button an aria-label or an sr-only text child so assistive technology announces what the button does.

confirmedIssues: Appending and reordering could remount or reuse the wrong input.
Row inputs and remove buttons lacked accessible names.
Delayed file completion could restore stale edits; superseded or unmounted readers must not commit.
Switching deployments must reset secret reveal state and cancel the previous import.

guidance.indexRule: Canonical 200 with plugin version drift; matched pinned local rules explain used.
guidance.iconRule: Canonical 404; matched pinned local rules explain used.
